title: P2Flow: Phoneme-aware Progressive Flow Matching for Extreme Speech Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2609.24138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative models have recently demonstrated considerable promise in speech super-resolution (SSR). Nevertheless, the majority of existing work has concentrated on standard or versatile SSR configurations, leaving the extreme setting with severely limited spectral inputs largely unexplored. In this regime, current approaches exhibit marked performance degradation, underscoring the need for dedicated solutions. To bridge this gap, we introduce P2Flow, a phoneme-aware progressive flow matching (FM) framework designed for extreme SSR with three main strategies. First, our model leverages phonetic information to reconstruct missing spectral components. Furthermore, it employs a progressive architectural design that hierarchically restores distinct frequency regions. translated_title: P2Flow：面向极致语音超分辨率的音素感知渐进流匹配
translated_abstract: 生成式模型近来在语音超分辨率（SSR）任务上展现出了巨大潜力。然而，现有工作大多集中在标准或通用型SSR配置上，对于频谱输入严重受限的极致设定则鲜有探索。在这一设定下，现有方法出现明显的性能下降，凸显了对专用解决方案的需求。为填补这一空白，我们提出了P2Flow，一个专为极致SSR设计的音素感知渐进流匹配（FM）框架，包含三种主要策略。首先，我们的模型利用音素信息来重建缺失的频谱成分；其次，它采用渐进式的架构设计，分层恢复不同的频率区域；最后，我们引入声码器的后训练以提升整体波形的保真度。我们在TIMIT和VCTK数据集上，在1 kHz（输入）等多种实验条件下进行了大量实验……
tldr: 提出音素感知的渐进式流匹配框架P2Flow，通过利用音素信息重建缺失频谱、分层渐进恢复频率区域并对声码器进行后训练，解决了频谱输入严重受限的极致语音超分辨率问题。
en_tdlr: P2Flow is a phoneme-aware progressive flow matching framework that reconstructs missing spectral components using phonetic information, hierarchically restores frequency bands, and post-trains the vocoder to tackle extreme speech super-resolution with severely limited spectral input.
